crossRefs.note: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against…
He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

parallels.note: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against…

translations.web: The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
translations.bsb: So the high priest stood up and asked Him, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
translations.kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
translations.asv: And the high priest stood up, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
